# When to use

A brand-new **marketing / landing site** brief — "build a dentist landing
page", "a marketing site for my bakery", "a landing page for my SaaS",
"an agency site that captures leads". The output is published as a **Paw
Site**: rendered statically (server-side, `csr=false`) and deployed to
the edge. The pocket is stamped `type="site"` + `pattern="landing"`.

This is NOT a dashboard. A landing page is a conversion funnel read top
to bottom: nav → hero → services → social proof → pricing → CTA → lead
form → footer. Compose by **conversion role**, not by metric.

Use this AS-IS for any single-business landing page. Adapt the copy +
service names + tier prices for the specific domain (dentist, salon,
bakery, agency, SaaS, gym, law firm).

# The static-render contract (why the rules below are hard)

The site is prerendered HTML and works with **no JavaScript**. The site
template wraps the page in one outer `<form method="POST">` so a native
submit posts the lead. Five rules follow from that, and every one of
them was a real failure on a real render:

1. **Lead form = flat native inputs.** Build the lead form from flat
   `input` / `textarea` / `button{type:"submit"}` with real `name=`,
   placed directly in a `card` / `section`. **NEVER the `form` or
   `newsletter` widget** — they emit their own nested `<form>`, which is
   invalid inside the template's outer form, so the browser drops it and
   the page captures zero leads.
2. **`pricing-table` uses `tiers`.** The required array prop is `tiers`
   (not `plans`, not `columns`). Wrong key → an empty pricing table.
3. **FAQ = flat `heading` + `text` pairs.** **NEVER `accordion`** — it's
   a client primitive whose panels only open with JS, so on a static
   site the answers never expand.
4. **Every CTA is an anchor `href`** (e.g. `#book`, `tel:`, `mailto:`).
   An `on_click` CTA needs JS and is a dead button on a static site. The
   lead form's submit is the only native action.
5. **`hero` is the marketing Hero widget** — never the dashboard
   `hero+grid` (a `page-header` + KPI `stat` grid). No KPI tiles, no
   charts on a sales page.

Animated polish is allowed but **Tier-0 (CSS-only, static-safe) only**:
`aurora`, `marquee`, `border-beam`, `shimmer`, `animated-beam`,
`text-effect`, `bento-grid`. NEVER `reveal` / `parallax` / `spotlight`
(they need client JS — reveal-on-scroll hides the section on a static
render).

# Composition

A dentist landing page. Root is a `flex` column; each conversion role is
a section with an `id` the navbar + CTA anchors target.

```json
{
  "version": "1.0",
  "ui": {
    "type": "flex",
    "props": { "direction": "column", "gap": "0" },
    "children": [
      { "type": "navbar", "props": {
          "brand": "Bright Smile Dental",
          "links": [
            { "label": "Services", "href": "#services" },
            { "label": "Pricing",  "href": "#pricing" },
            { "label": "Reviews",  "href": "#reviews" },
            { "label": "Book",     "href": "#book" }
          ],
          "cta": { "label": "Book a visit", "href": "#book" }
      }},

      { "type": "hero", "props": {
          "eyebrow": "Family & cosmetic dentistry",
          "title": "Care that fits your whole family",
          "subtitle": "Gentle, modern dentistry in downtown Austin. Same-week appointments, transparent pricing, no surprises.",
          "cta": { "label": "Book your visit", "href": "#book" }
      }},

      { "type": "feature-grid", "props": {
          "id": "services",
          "title": "What we do",
          "features": [
            { "icon": "tooth",   "title": "New Patient Exams", "description": "Full exam, digital X-rays, and a cleaning in one visit." },
            { "icon": "sparkles","title": "Teeth Whitening",   "description": "In-office whitening up to 8 shades brighter in an hour." },
            { "icon": "smile",   "title": "Invisalign",        "description": "Clear aligners with a custom plan and free consult." },
            { "icon": "shield",  "title": "Emergency Care",    "description": "Same-day relief for pain, chips, and lost fillings." }
          ]
      }},

      { "type": "testimonial", "props": {
          "id": "reviews",
          "quote": "Best dental experience I've had. They explained every option and the cleaning was painless.",
          "author": "Maria G.",
          "role": "Patient since 2023",
          "rating": 5
      }},

      { "type": "pricing-table", "props": {
          "id": "pricing",
          "title": "Simple, upfront pricing",
          "currency": "USD",
          "tiers": [
            { "id": "exam",   "name": "New Patient Exam", "price": "$89",  "period": "one-time",
              "features": ["Full exam", "Digital X-rays", "Cleaning"],
              "cta": { "label": "Book", "href": "#book" } },
            { "id": "white",  "name": "Whitening",        "price": "$299", "period": "one-time", "popular": true,
              "features": ["In-office session", "Up to 8 shades", "Take-home trays"],
              "cta": { "label": "Book", "href": "#book" } },
            { "id": "invis",  "name": "Invisalign",       "price": "$3,900", "period": "full plan",
              "features": ["Custom aligners", "All visits", "Retainers included"],
              "cta": { "label": "Free consult", "href": "#book" } }
          ]
      }},

      { "type": "cta", "props": {
          "title": "Ready for a healthier smile?",
          "subtitle": "Same-week appointments are filling up.",
          "cta": { "label": "Request an appointment", "href": "#book" }
      }},

      { "type": "card", "props": { "id": "book", "title": "Book your visit" },
        "children": [
          { "type": "input",    "props": { "name": "name",  "label": "Your name", "placeholder": "Jane Doe", "required": true } },
          { "type": "input",    "props": { "name": "email", "label": "Email", "type": "email", "placeholder": "jane@email.com", "required": true } },
          { "type": "input",    "props": { "name": "phone", "label": "Phone", "type": "tel", "placeholder": "(555) 010-1234" } },
          { "type": "textarea", "props": { "name": "message", "label": "What do you need?", "placeholder": "I'd like a checkup and cleaning..." } },
          { "type": "button",   "props": { "label": "Request appointment", "type": "submit", "variant": "primary" } }
        ]
      },

      { "type": "footer", "props": {
          "brand": "Bright Smile Dental",
          "tagline": "421 Congress Ave, Austin TX · (555) 010-1234",
          "links": [
            { "label": "Services", "href": "#services" },
            { "label": "Pricing",  "href": "#pricing" },
            { "label": "Book",     "href": "#book" }
          ]
      }}
    ]
  }
}
```

For an animated hero, wrap the `hero` in (or set a backdrop of) `aurora`
— it animates with pure CSS and survives a JS-off render. A `marquee` of
client logos and a `border-beam` on the popular pricing tier are also
safe.

# Anti-patterns to avoid

- ❌ Lead form built with the `form` or `newsletter` widget → nests an invalid `<form>` inside the template's outer form; the submit silently no-ops. Use **flat** `input` + `button{type:"submit"}` with real `name=`.
- ❌ `pricing-table` with `plans` or `columns` → empty table. Use `tiers`.
- ❌ FAQ built with `accordion` → answers never open with JS off. Use `heading` + `text` pairs.
- ❌ CTA with `on_click` → dead button on a static site. Use anchor `href`.
- ❌ A `page-header` + grid of KPI `stat` tiles at the top (the dashboard `hero+grid`) → reads as an internal tool, not a sales page. Use the `hero` widget.
- ❌ `reveal` / `parallax` / `spotlight` animation → needs client JS; reveal-on-scroll hides the section on a static render. Stay Tier-0.

# Variations

- **Salon / barber**: services become Cut / Color / Treatment; testimonial → before/after note; tiers are service prices.
- **SaaS**: hero subhead is the value prop; `feature-grid` is product capabilities; pricing `tiers` are Free / Pro / Team; add a `logo-cloud` of customer logos under the hero.
- **Agency**: `feature-grid` is the service lines; testimonial is a client quote; the lead form swaps `phone` for a `company` field; CTA → "Book a discovery call" with a `mailto:` or `#book` anchor.
- **Restaurant / bakery**: `feature-grid` is the menu highlights; pricing `tiers` become a sample menu; footer carries hours + address; CTA is "Reserve a table" (`#book`).
- **Gym / studio**: tiers are membership plans (Drop-in / Monthly / Annual), mark the Monthly one `popular`; hero CTA is "Start free week" (`#book`).
